title: An introduction to trading Bitcoin with Mirror Trading International
description: An introduction to Mirror Trading International (MTI). How to grow your Bitcoin and make a passive income with MTI. Mirror ...

asr.full_text: Meru trading international PTY LTD is a South African registered company offering crypto trading services by using an automated system to trade with a trading pool on behalf of its members. No trading knowledge is required and we take the hassle out of Cryptotrading by doing its all for you, creating a truly passive income. Johan Steinberg from Polokwani in South Africa is the CEO and founder of Mirror Trading international The company's head office is based in Stellenbosch, Western Cape, South Africa Growing your bitcoin is at the very heart of Mirror Trading international and Johan's vision for the company is to provide its members with a passive and sustainable income currently MTI boasts over 185,000 active members in over 190 countries worldwide and these numbers are growing daily. Mirra Trading International has an impressive 18,000 Bitcoin and counting in trade daily. NTI offers a reasonable daily profit from the daily trades. The company does not overstate the potential, making unrealistic promises or gives any guarantees. Trading and other bonuses are dependent on the daily trade results, so no profit for the day means no trading or other bonuses. This makes the company sustainable, the company does not rely on the growth in member numbers to remain sustainable, as members receive trading bonuses from the daily trades, and not from new members joining the organization. It is a company for the person who just wants to grow their Bitcoin as well as offering an optional referral program for networkers who like to build a team. Members who decide to participate in the referral program can qualify for referral, binary and leadership bonuses. The binary bonus system is unique amongst network companies as these and are paid out weekly on recurring volume.

textual.context: Promotional context is indicated by the introduction and first-person company statements. The records do not establish whether the claims are accurate or whether any audience member transferred assets.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised passive income and Bitcoin growth outcome is linked to participation in an automated crypto-trading service, which requires later assessment of the service terms and the actual relationship between membership and returns.
textual.limitations: The records do not state a required deposit, fee, enrollment procedure, specific return amount, or verified trading outcome.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it markets Mirror Trading International as an automated Bitcoin trading pool that can provide passive income, although a federal court later found MTI liable for fraud in its pool operations. It also solicits team-building through referral, binary and leadership bonuses; the speaker's denial of guarantees does not change which adjudicated program the video promotes.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S03 is primary for depositing Bitcoin into the claimed managed trading pool; S06 captures the explicit team-building and recurring binary-bonus structure. The video supplies the promotional claims, while the CFTC court-order report supplies project-level fraud context.
